info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v3-spec
info.description: This API allows users to withdraw their submitted career applications through a straightforward process. By sending a DELETE request to the specified endpoint, applicants can easily remove their applications from consideration. This functionality is particularly useful for job seekers who have changed their mind about a position. Typically, this endpoint is utilized by candidates managing their application statuses in response to changing circumstances or opportunities.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw their application. Once an application is withdrawn, it cannot be reactivated. Ensure that this action is intended.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the user to withdraw an application. It requires specific parameters to be included in the JSON format.

200.description: The withdrawal request was processed successfully.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to withdraw applications.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.title: Withdraw Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the withdrawal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: Current state of the application after the withdrawal.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the withdrawal request in milliseconds.

message.description: Informative message regarding the withdrawal operation.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for a successful withdrawal of an application.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user or system that created the withdrawal record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the withdrawal record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit related to the withdrawal operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed instantaneously, while higher values indicate longer processing times.
